name: Open Press
summary: A public-graphics identity with the energy of assembled paper, forceful type and a clear invitation to make something.

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source slide 4 / title2.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source slide 4 / footer.

recognitionRules: Use Impact OPEN PRESS lettering with a vertical spine and a contrasting title strip.
Keep the paper-and-red palette tactile without reducing text contrast.
Use American Typewriter only for a secondary workshop-note voice.
On the reverse, organize the activity into numbered paper-like steps.

principles: Invite attention before offering interpretation; keep object facts and imaginative response distinct.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: You make it. You keep it. Start with one shape.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid prescribing a viewer’s feelings or implying unverified provenance.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Look at the edge, then read the record.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use OPEN PRESS as an offset two-line Impact wordmark with a red rectangular strip behind PRESS. Keep the uneven assembly deliberate, not randomly distressed.
invariants: Use Impact OPEN PRESS lettering with a vertical spine and a contrasting title strip.
Keep the paper-and-red palette tactile without reducing text contrast.
Use American Typewriter only for a secondary workshop-note voice.
adaptations: Posters may use larger paper overlaps; instructions use flat, quiet fields.
A one-color edition keeps the spine and offset title geometry.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Impact is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.
Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: One PRESS strip inset around the outside of the combined OPEN and offset strip silhouette.

minimumSize.status: Conservative production recommendation after inspection at primary220px, secondary180px and symbols32/64px. Trial Ledger record code and Orbit descriptor motivate larger full-lockup minima; use secondary in narrow spaces.
